summary: Saturday's the day: clean SE swell region-wide with offshore mornings, and Ditch Plains is the pick at a prime 2.5ft if you want the best of it — otherwise Rockaway's plenty for a fun home log session. Sunday builds a hair with more period but wind turns onshore at most spots, making Manasquan (3.2ft, cross-off early) the one drive worth considering. After that it goes small and windy midweek — Wednesday's NE gale blows out the eastern spots — so front-load your weekend.
